name: personal-agent
description: A personal AI agent built with the Claude Agent SDK

LLM_PROVIDER.description: Which LLM backend to use: 'anthropic' or 'gemini'.

API_KEY.description: API key for the active provider (Anthropic or Gemini, depending on LLM_PROVIDER).

LLM_MODEL.description: Optional model override. Provider defaults apply if unset.

LLM_MAX_TURNS.description: Max agent loop turns per request (default 10).

EXTERNAL_MCP_URL.description: Optional remote MCP server URL (e.g. hello-mcp on CloudHub). Leave blank to disable.

EXTERNAL_MCP_SERVER_NAME.description: Display/registration name for the external MCP server.
